_schema.ATTRIBUTE_PROCESS_NAME: string (required) - existing process that receives a run-unique custom attribute for the attribute filter test; not the Test_002 process, whose afterAll deletes every attribute
_schema.CALENDAR_NAME: string (required) - calendar used by the calendarName filter
_schema.STATUS_FILTER: string (required) - raw node status sent as the PSR 'PO Attribute Search' filter
_schema.STATUS_DISPLAY: object (required) - raw node status -> display value the search returns
_schema.STATUS_IN_FILTER: string[] (required) - raw statuses used for the IN filter
_schema.PAGE_NUMBER_PAST_END: number (required) - page number beyond the last page
_schema.ALL_ROWS_PAGE_SIZE: number (required) - page size large enough to return every process
_schema.ROW_STRING_KEYS: string[] (required) - keys every row carries as a string
_schema.VALIDATION_ERROR_CODE: string (required) - errorCode for a bean validation failure
_schema.INVALID_JSON_ERROR_CODE: string (required) - errorCode for a missing or malformed body
